personas.dave: Southern markets (ES, IT, FR), no in.c-sales.deals

examples.label: Rows per country — invoices
examples.sql:
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM "in.c-crm"."invoices"
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 20

examples.label: Top 10 invoices by amount
examples.sql:
SELECT id, country, amount
FROM "in.c-crm"."invoices"
ORDER BY amount DESC
LIMIT 10

examples.label: Orders by country and status
examples.sql:
SELECT country, status, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM "in.c-crm"."orders"
WHERE status IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC
LIMIT 25

examples.label: Join invoices and orders per country
examples.sql:
SELECT i.country, COUNT(*) AS matched_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders
FROM "in.c-crm"."invoices" AS i
JOIN "in.c-crm"."orders" AS o ON o.customer_id = i.customer_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 20

examples.label: Deals by stage — in.c-sales.deals (refused for dave)
examples.sql:
SELECT country, stage, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM "in.c-sales"."deals"
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC
LIMIT 25
